# laravelforge_composer_credentials (Resource)

Create composer credentials for the site

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelforge_composer_credentials" "example" {
  organization = "my-org"
  password     = "example-password"
  repository   = "example-repository"
  server       = 123456
  site         = 123456
  username     = "example-username"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization slug
- `password` (String, Sensitive)
- `repository` (String)
- `server` (Number) The server ID
- `site` (Number) The site ID
- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import laravelforge_composer_credentials.example my-org/123456/123456/123
```
